chunks: A number of our companions, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from al-Husayn ibn Sa'id, from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn ibn Saghir, from one who narrated to him, from Rib'i ibn 'Abdallah, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), that he

said: God refused to cause things to proceed except through causes. Thus He appointed a cause for every thing, and appointed an explanation for every cause, and appointed a knowledge for every explanation, and appointed a speaking gate for every knowledge. He who recognized it recognized him, and he who was ignorant of it was ignorant of him. That is the Messenger of God (peace be upon him and his family) and us.

key_terms.أَسْبَاب: Causes — the causal order through which God runs all affairs
key_terms.بَاب نَاطِق: Speaking gate — the living, authoritative guide who embodies divine knowledge; a title for the Prophet and Imams
key_terms.شَرْح: Explanation/elaboration — the elucidation that accompanies every cause
key_terms.عَرَفَهُ مَنْ عَرَفَهُ: He who recognized him recognized — recognition of the Imam is the recognition of the full divine order

ai.seo_question: What does Imam al-Sadiq say about causes and the speaking gate of knowledge?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) articulates a cosmological and theological principle: God has ordained that all affairs operate through a chain of causes, explanations, and knowledge — each link dependent on the one before it. At the apex of this chain is a 'speaking gate' (bab natiq) — a living, authoritative guide who embodies and transmits divine knowledge. The Imam identifies this gate as the Prophet Muhammad and the Imams themselves, establishing the doctrine that recognition of the Imam is the very culmination of the divinely instituted causal order. This hadith, from the Chapter on Recognition of the Imam, was addressed to Shi'i communities in the era of al-Sadiq's imamate (d. 148 AH), a period of intense theological debate, to affirm that bypassing the Imam's authority is equivalent to bypassing the entire chain through which God runs the universe.
